description: This file defines the AppIdentityDbContext class, a custom Entity Framework Core DbContext derived from IdentityDbContext for managing identity and authentication-related data in the eShopOnWeb application. It sets up the database context with options and allows for model customization.

classes.name: AppIdentityDbContext
classes.description: A custom database context for ASP.NET Identity, managing user-related data using Entity Framework Core.

methods.name: AppIdentityDbContext
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the DbContext with specified options.

methods.name: OnModelCreating
methods.description: Overrides the base method to allow customization of the ASP.NET Identity model during model creation.
